notes.title: HOTFIX 1 (v2.thenakedgame)
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
looks like we've made a hotfix for you.

 we added inverted y mouse axis

 we added czech localization (interface and subtitles)

 we added an option called  "the last notes"  which allows you to finish with reading of the last notes in the game if you didn't manage it at the end

 we fixed several small bugs
 
Thank you for your support !
